title: 🎡 Interactive Spin Wheel – Fun Decision-Making Tool with HTML, CSS & JS
description:
🎯 Spin Wheel – Interactive Random Picker

Looking for a fun way to make decisions or add a gamified experience to your projects? This Spin Wheel Tool is built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with the power of Chart.js for smooth animations.

🛠️ Features:
✅ Canvas-Based Wheel – Customizable and scalable 🎨
✅ Randomized Spins – Uses JavaScript logic to select values 🎰
✅ Smooth Animations – Leveraging CSS & Chart.js for dynamic effects ✨
✅ Responsive Design – Works on all screen sizes 📱
✅ User-Friendly UI – Simple click-to-spin button 🖱️

🔹 How It Works:
1️⃣ Click the Spin button 🎲
2️⃣ The wheel spins dynamically 🔄
3️⃣ A random value is selected based on predefined angles 🎯
4️⃣ The result is displayed to the user 📢

💡 Use Cases:

  • Lucky Draws 🍀

  • Decision Makers 🏆

  • Games & Raffles 🎮

  • Random Generators 🎭

⚡ Enhance it further! Customize colors, add more values, or integrate with APIs for dynamic data. 🚀
shortDescription: Create an engaging Spin Wheel tool using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! 🌀 This interactive wheel lets users spin and get a random result dynamically. Uses Chart.js for smooth animations. Perfect for games, raffles, or random picks! 🚀
